note: Monterey County park at the edge of King City off Highway 101, next to the Salinas Valley Fairgrounds. Day-use lawns, playgrounds and a walking trail run along the Salinas River (usually a dry or low channel), and the park holds the county's agricultural and rural-life museum. The gate is locked overnight; hours vary by month. --Claude
summary: Live county page refuses even the headless browser, so it was read from Wayback (2026-05-17 park page, 2026-11-13 rates page); live Rec1 catalog read for sites and rates. 94 bookable hookup sites (26 full hookup at $55, water/electric $45-50), 30 A, pull-throughs 1-72, showers, laundry, dump, 14-night max. Not waterfront confirmed (river channel ~250-300 m away behind trees). Pin fine (107 m from the OSM campground). Phone and website updates below.
flags: PHONE: '' -> 831-755-4895 (Monterey County Parks business line, which the catalog also gives for this park); reservations 831-755-4899; toll-free 888-588-2267.

WEBSITE: stored https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/government/departments-a-h/administrative-office/parks/park-locations/southern-lake-county/san-lorenzo-park is the old structure (no Wayback capture, not reachable) -> https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/government/departments-i-z/public-works-facilities-parks/county-parks/list-of-county-parks/san-lorenzo-park (403 to automated clients, captured 2026-05-17); booking https://secure.rec1.com/CA/monterey-county-ca/catalog.

GATE CLOSES: the park gate keeps day hours (8 am to 5 pm Nov-Feb, to 8 pm May-Aug) and Rec1 warns campers to pack up an hour before closing to be out before the gate shuts. Late arrivals may be locked out; worth a reviewer glance, not a drop.
RATES: $45 applies to only 6 water/electric sites; most are $50. Rec1's rate records carry old recurrence-end dates (2018-2024, one 2099) but are the ones the live catalog attaches to each site.
SITES COUNT: county pages say 99 sites (83 hook-up + 10 tent + others); Rec1 lists 94 bookable ones, all with hookup rates (sites 72-75 and 99 are absent).

DISCOUNT: California Distinguished Veteran pass holders get a camping discount by phone (14 consecutive nights, 30 a year). Not written to discounts.military: a state DV pass isn't a general military discount.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront agrees. On Esri imagery the campground loops (around the pin) sit ~250-300 m north of the Salinas River's wetted channel, behind the park's tree belt and the riverside trail; no site is near the water. Season not stated (rates cover the whole year), so not written. Status not written: the catalog is taking reservations.
